people.name: Gideon
people.line: Judge of Israel; defeated Midianites; tested and reassured by God.

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

people.name: Midian
people.line: A nation descended from Abraham; oppressed Israel in the time of the judges

translations.web: So Midian was subdued before the children of Israel, and they lifted up their heads no more. The land had rest forty years in the days of Gideon.
translations.bsb: In this way Midian was subdued before the Israelites and did not raise its head again. So the land had rest for forty years in the days of Gideon,
translations.kjv: Thus was Midian subdued before the children of Israel, so that they lifted up their heads no more. And the country was in quietness forty years in the days of Gideon.
translations.asv: So Midian was subdued before the children of Israel, and they lifted up their heads no more. And the land had rest forty years in the days of Gideon.
